issues: The fuse beat was a small white keycap on light grey, under 6% of the frame, with no product-shot volume or environment light
The roar flew grey-bar placeholder cards in scattered directions; nothing was readable and the energy did not peak before the cut
The post-cut panorama was a grey placeholder dashboard: the 'verdict' frame said nothing, and the keycap in the top bar was nearly invisible
The shock ring was a flat circle that ignored the tabletop perspective
changes: Graphite look (near-monochrome dark): a 300px black anodised ⌘K keycap with a tapered top, visible skirt thickness and a slight top-down tilt, a pool of top light on the table, a hover-dependent contact shadow and a 'Press ⌘K to begin' prompt

The 3f press squashes the skirt from 34 to 6px, drops the top 40px onto the table and darkens it; the ring is now a 0.3-flattened perspective ellipse (out-cubic growth, linear fade, decoupled) with one light spill from under the key

The roar is a warp: six dark glass panels (command row, p95 41ms, issue, approvals, build chart, merged branch) burst radially from the centre in two passes, ease-in all the way, 0.7 to 3.2 scale, radial speed blur; 48 speed lines, a centre bloom and a 1 to 1.5 table push all ease in, so the frame before the cut is the fullest

The smash cut goes dark to light: a bone-white still with a 96px headline (Everything, one keystroke away.) and a full Quarry app window with the command palette open and Deploy to production ⌘⏎ highlighted; the same black keycap sits at 48px at the end of the search field, echoing the fuse
Nothing animates after the cut (grain is frozen too): 82f of silence, 140f total
